caption: The drawing consists of three main object views and an information box, all outlined in black lines on a light beige background. The top view shows a rectangular surface labeled "TOP IS ONE PIECE OF PINE 21 1/2'' x 50''" inside a double-lined border. Below, the front view of a rectangular chest with three large arches on its main face is depicted, measuring 53 inches in width and 24 1/8 inches in height; the chest has a decorative bottom edge and a horizontal molding beneath the top. A small keyhole detail is shown at the center arch. To the right, the side view of the chest is presented, 23 inches wide and matching the height, featuring a single arch on the visible side. Adjacent to this, an information box contains text specifying the scale (1/8"=1'), the object's name (Dower Chest), the wood material (yellow pine, painted), the reference number (#34.100.8), the room location (Room L 5, Metro. M.), and the maker's name (John Dieterich). The lines are clean and the layout is organized with labeled dimensions for clarity. The drawing is monochromatic, with all lines and text in black.
title: Pa. German Dower Chest
